Two camps who will get the final stint of their pre-World Cup preparations underway on Monday night, Austria will welcome Tunisia to Vienna.

Starting with the hosts, embarking on what was a sensational World Cup qualifying adventure last year, Austria are clearly relishing life under Ralf Rangnick’s guidance. Rightfully receiving a string of plaudits from across the continent, the former Manchester United boss certainly finds the mood in his camp at a real high. Last seen putting in another gritty performance as they clinched a 1-0 victory against South Korea when signing off March’s international break, Das Team have suffered just a single defeat from any of their previous 10 appearances across all competitions. With their sights set on mounting a genuine World Cup knockout stage charge next month when they get proceedings underway against Jordan on June 17th, Austria will be desperate to extend on their extended flurry here.
[...]
As for the visitors, while Tunisia might be preparing for their third consecutive World Cup adventure this summer, Sabri Lamouchi’s side are desperately searching for some crucial stability. Last seen getting April underway with an uneventful 0-0 stalemate against Canada, the one-time Nottingham Forest boss has seen his squad register just a single victory from any of their previous five appearances across all competitions. Enduring a real AFCON struggle back in January and watching their campaign come to a Round of 16 end against Mali, Tunisia have also struggled to find any kind of clinical edge. While all their focus might be set on June 15th when they get their World Cup charge underway against Sweden, Lamouchi’s camp are hoping to find a much-welcomed boost on Monday night.

Meeting a downbeat Tunisia side on Monday night, Austria should be confident of extending on their extended flurry in Vienna.
